title: If a theater is designed to look like a bar you know I will be sat!!!...
transcript: if you're looking for a totally unique new queer musical to support this pride you must see Beau at the Out of the box theatrics this show feels like a whole immersive experience because Beau is set have completely redesigned this theater it feels super intimate I got to sit at one of the tables and the actors were performing in front of you beside you behind you it was very very cool and all of the musicians are also the actors in the show So it’s an Incredibly talented Group of people lead by matt rodin who plays ace baker Ace is a musician Who has just released his new album and as he plays each song he tells the audience the inspiration behind it and you watch through a series of flashbacks as Ace shares his childhood As a young gay kid Growing up in Tennessee and the most foundational relationship of the life The one with his grandfather beau I loved the story and the music there are some extraordinarily fun numbers And also ones that’ll make you cry and I cannot hype up Matt Rodin enough who is an unreal vocalist and actor beau is a show that is just full of heart and full of so many relevant themes and this is the kind of theatre that needs and should be uplifted go see beau it’s running until July 27nd
classificationReason: Creator attended 'Beau' at Out of the Box Theatrics and shares a clear first-hand opinion with recommendation, but this show does not appear in the provided list.
